_comment: QWEN DESKTOP (official Windows/macOS Electron app, and the qwen-studio Linux port). Qwen's MCP integration is NON-standard — see ../RESEARCH-qwen-desktop.md. Key facts: (1) config is managed by the desktop shell, not chat.qwen.ai (Settings -> MCP / Tools in the app UI); (2) the official app rewrites command 'npx' to its bundled 'bun x' and REPLACES PATH with its resources dir, so use ABSOLUTE paths for node/python exactly as the installer resolves them; (3) in qwen-studio the config lives in ~/.config/qwen-studio/settings.json under mcpServers. Set PLAN_AUDIT_MAP_PROVIDER so the wire tap tags events correctly.
